reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: p0001 expressly states nothing creates an exclusive arrangement and that the Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or selling to third parties, which directly satisfies the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer).

The only Customer prohibitions identified (p0025) are ordinary license-scope/IP protections (no transfer, third-party access, reverse engineering, resale or service-bureau use of Kubient's Service) and do not restrain Customer's businesses, purchases, or internal development, so they are correctly excluded from the rule's scope.

No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered text is unchanged from the original paragraphs and the deterministic check confirms no open-ended compete restriction on Customer remains.
Party identification is correct (The Associated Press is the Customer / our side; restrictions binding Kubient would be acceptable in any event).
